## NULL window boundary offsets

# Error from GoogleSQL's analytic_window_frames and analytic_numeric_range_window_frames
# compliance tests.
DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY x RANGE BETWEEN n PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The boundary offset value cannot be null

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY x RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND n PRECEDING) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The boundary offset value cannot be null

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY x RANGE BETWEEN n FOLLOWING AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The boundary offset value cannot be null

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY x RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND n FOLLOWING) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The boundary offset value cannot be null

DECLARE n NUMERIC DEFAULT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(x AS NUMERIC) RANGE BETWEEN n PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The boundary offset value cannot be null

## RANGE window frames ordered by INT64 near the type's limits

# A frame's bound past INT64's limits, from a key near them or from a large offset. Answers
# observed on BigQuery.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(s ORDER BY k) FROM (SELECT k, SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS s FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(9223372036854775805 AS k, 1 AS v), (9223372036854775807, 2)]))
=> [{"v":"3"},{"v":"2"}]

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(s ORDER BY k) FROM (SELECT k, SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS s FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(-9223372036854775808 AS k, 1 AS v), (-9223372036854775806, 2)]))
=> [{"v":"1"},{"v":"3"}]

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(s ORDER BY k) FROM (SELECT k, SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 9223372036854775807 FOLLOWING) AS s FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(-9223372036854775808 AS k, 1 AS v), (-1, 2), (0, 4)]))
=> [{"v":"3"},{"v":"6"},{"v":"4"}]

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(s ORDER BY k) FROM (SELECT k, SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY k DESC RANGE BETWEEN 9223372036854775807 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS s FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(-9223372036854775808 AS k, 1 AS v), (0, 2), (9223372036854775807, 4)]))
=> [{"v":"1"},{"v":"6"},{"v":"4"}]
